decisions.decision: Board of Health set out its comments to the Sewer Commission on the Comprehensive Waste Water Management Plan and the proposed Lunenburg Sewer By-Law (flows, septage, Title 5/I-A authority, sewer district powers, future expansion, lakes areas). No vote recorded.
decisions.quote: comments to the sewer commission are as follows:

decisions.decision: Board stated it would not consider a Septage Management Plan until the CWMP has been completed and approved. No vote recorded.
